description: Patch one Kubernetes resource with kubectl patch.

name.description: Name of the resource to patch.

namespace.description: Namespace of the resource to patch; when omitted, the current-context default namespace is used.

patch.description: Patch content to apply to the resource, passed to kubectl patch with -p.

resource_type.description: Kubernetes resource type to patch, such as deployment or service.

name: kubectl_patch
